description: Use for 'how big could a GDPR fine be?' or 'how are GDPR fines calculated?'. Applies step 2 of the EDPB Guidelines 04/2022 method: the Art. 83(4) or 83(5) legal maximum, the starting amount band for the seriousness of the infringement, and the turnover adjustment. Give the seriousness, or the facts to let ClevSec suggest it. Returns a starting range in EUR, not a prediction of a real fine.

annual_turnover_eur.description: Total worldwide annual turnover of the undertaking in the preceding financial year, in EUR

data_categories.description: basic contact data, financial, other personal (e.g. location), special categories (Art. 9), children's data, criminal data (Art. 10)

duration.description: short: under a month; medium: 1 to 12 months; long: over a year

fault.description: low: measures in place but one failed; clear: a known risk not addressed; intent: intentional or against advice

infringement_tier.description: 83(4): controller/processor obligations such as security (Art. 32) and breach notification (Arts. 33-34). 83(5): principles, legal basis, data subject rights, transfers

seriousness.description: Seriousness per EDPB Guidelines 04/2022 para. 60; omit to have it suggested from the facts below

name: gdpr_fine_estimate
title: GDPR fine starting range (EDPB method)
